Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

weather — the state of the air outside. Example: What is the weather like?
sunny — with a lot of sun. Example: Tomorrow it is sunny.
rainy — with a lot of rain. Example: Yesterday it was rainy.
windy — with a lot of wind. Example: In autumn it is windy.
cold — with a low temperature. Example: It is cold in winter.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What is the weather like?
• It is sunny.
• It is cold today.
• It is rainy.
• It is windy.
